title: IT Outsourcing - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the IT Outsourcing market is projected to reach US$618.36bn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 5.85%, resulting in a market volume of US$821.55bn by 2031.
The average Spend per Employee in the IT Outsourcing market is projected to reach US$167.56 in 2026.
In global comparison, most revenue will be generated United States (US$225.26bn in 2026).
